candidates.computation_change_reason: Interpretation of which pollutants are covered by Table 1 and whether the cross-reference to Element I, Section I resolves correctly affects which numeric pollutant concentrations are subject to limit comparison (A), which substances must be monitored or recorded (B), and whether absent concentration records count as missing required evidence (C).

candidates.exact_span: The annual whole sludge application rate for the sewage sludge that does not cause the annual pollutant loading rates in Table 4 to be exceeded.
candidates.computation_change_reason: This ties land-application activity to Table 4 annual pollutant loading rates; different readings of when AWSAR limits apply or how exceedance is measured would change which enforceable numeric limits are in scope and whether reported loadings can be compared to a limit.

candidates.exact_span: See Appendix A to Part 503 - Procedure to Determine the Annual Whole Sludge Application Rate for Sewage Sludge.
candidates.computation_change_reason: The referenced procedure governs how the annual whole sludge application rate is calculated; alternative readings of that method or its incorporation here could change the derived numeric loading limit used for compliance comparison.

candidates.exact_span: A description of how the Class A pathogen reduction requirements are met.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Whether this recordkeeping item establishes or substitutes for a monitoring obligation affects which pathogen-related requirements are deemed applicable (B) and how missing pathogen documentation is classified when no ordinary numeric result is present (C).

candidates.exact_span: A description of how the vector attraction reduction requirements are met.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Interpretation of this descriptive recordkeeping requirement versus an enforceable monitoring duty affects applicability of vector-attraction obligations (B) and whether absent documentation is treated as missing evidence or a documented alternative compliance pathway (C).

candidates.exact_span: The permittee shall report annually on the DMR the following information:
candidates.computation_change_reason: The annual DMR reporting cadence constrains when sludge-related data must be submitted; different readings of 'annually' versus more frequent monitoring referenced elsewhere could change which monitoring periods are obligated (B) and how gaps without DMR entries are categorized (C).

candidates.exact_span: List Pollutant Table 4 appropriate for permittee's land application practices.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Which Table 4 pollutants are 'appropriate' depends on how land application practices are interpreted, changing the set of enforceable loading-rate limits in scope (A) and the pollutant list that must be reported or monitored (B).

candidates.exact_span: The frequency of monitoring listed in Element 1, Section I.C. which applies to the permittee.
candidates.computation_change_reason: This cross-reference delegates monitoring frequency to Element 1, Section I.C.; resolving which frequency schedule applies to the permittee directly changes monitoring obligation determinations (B) and whether missing results reflect non-required periods versus inadequate evidence (C).

TCLP is reported as Pass/Fail rather than a concentration; interpretation of whether this functions as an enforceable numeric-equivalent limit or report-only criterion affects limit applicability and exceedance analysis (A) and whether TCLP monitoring was required (B).

candidates.exact_span: The concentration (mg/Kg) in the sludge of each pollutant listed in Table 1 (defined as a monthly average) found in Element 1, Section I.
candidates.computation_change_reason: This defines Table 1 pollutants, units (mg/Kg), and the 'monthly average' basis for reported concentrations; different readings affect which numeric limits apply and how measurements are aggregated for comparison (A), whether sub-annual monitoring is required despite annual DMR reporting (B), and how annual or partial data are treated when a monthly average is expected (C).

candidates.exact_span: Class A pathogen reduction Alternative used as listed in Section I.B.3.a.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Which Class A pathogen reduction alternative is selected determines the operative pathogen monitoring and documentation requirements tied to Section I.B.3.a, changing which obligations are deemed applicable.

candidates.exact_span: Vector attraction reduction Alternative used as listed in Section I.B.4.
candidates.computation_change_reason: The chosen vector attraction reduction alternative under Section I.B.4 governs which vector-attraction monitoring or demonstration requirements apply, affecting monitoring-obligation applicability.

candidates.exact_span: Annual sludge production in dry metric tons/year.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Reported production volume can condition whether sludge management and associated Table 1/Table 4 requirements are triggered; interpretation of production thresholds or zero-production periods affects limit applicability (A), reporting obligations (B), and classification of periods without numeric pollutant results (C).

candidates.exact_span: Amount of sludge land applied in dry metric tons/year.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Land-application quantity bears on whether Table 4 loading-rate limits and related land-application monitoring apply; different readings of zero or partial land application could change applicable limits (A), conditional monitoring requirements (B), and whether missing pollutant data reflects non-applicability or missing evidence (C).

candidates.exact_span: Amount of sludge transported interstate in dry metric tons/year.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Interstate transport reporting may activate or correlate with distinct sludge management obligations; interpretation of when transport triggers additional requirements affects which limits and monitoring duties are in scope (A, B) and how periods without ordinary numeric results are characterized (C).

candidates.exact_span: The following certification statement found in § 503.17(a)(6)(iii) shall be attached to the DMR.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Requiring the §503.17(a)(6)(iii) certification on the DMR establishes an expected form of compliance attestation; whether its absence or presence is treated as adequate evidence versus a missing-documentation state affects missing-evidence classification.

candidates.exact_span: I certify, under penalty of law, that the information that will be used to determine compliance with the management practices in §503.14(e), the Class A pathogen requirement in §503.32(a), and the vector attraction reduction requirement in (insert vector attraction reduction option) have been met.
candidates.computation_change_reason: The certification enumerates compliance dimensions (management practices, Class A pathogen, vector attraction) whose satisfaction is attested on the DMR; interpretation of which requirements are covered and what 'information ... will be used to determine compliance' encompasses affects whether numeric limit comparisons are applicable (A), which non-numeric obligations were in force (B), and what documented evidence suffices when numeric results are absent (C).
